# API reference

Roles are hierarchical: viewer < analyst < responder < admin. Authenticate with a session (SSO or API-key sign-in;
state-changing requests then need the `X-CSRF-Token` header equal to the `meridian_csrf` cookie), an `X-API-Key`
header, or `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` from your IdP.

## HTTP endpoints

| Method | Path | Minimum role / auth | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/healthz` | none | Liveness: the process is up. Used by container probes. |
| GET | `/readyz` | none | Readiness: store reachable, rules loaded, no placeholder secrets; reports role heartbeats. 503 when not ready. |
| GET | `/metrics` | Bearer MERIDIAN_METRICS_TOKEN | Prometheus metrics: work queue, cases, approvals, spend, heartbeats, per-source freshness. |
| GET | `/login` | none | API-key sign-in form (GET) and key exchange for a session cookie (POST). |
| POST | `/login` | none | API-key sign-in form (GET) and key exchange for a session cookie (POST). |
| GET | `/logout` | session | Clears the session. |
| GET | `/auth/login` | none | Starts OIDC sign-in (authorisation code + PKCE). |
| GET | `/auth/callback` | none | OIDC redirect URI; verifies the ID token and maps groups to a role. |
| GET | `/` | viewer | Console: cases, approvals, alerts, runs. |
| GET | `/cases/{case_id}` | viewer | Case page: timeline, notes, evidence, approvals. |
| GET | `/api/me` | viewer | Current principal and role. |
| GET | `/api/cases` | viewer | List cases (filter by status). |
| GET | `/api/cases/{case_id}` | viewer | Case with alerts, notes and approvals. |
| POST | `/api/cases/{case_id}/close` | analyst | Close a case with a verdict. |
| GET | `/api/alerts` | viewer | List alerts (filter by status, rule). |
| GET | `/api/approvals` | viewer | List approvals (pending by default). |
| POST | `/api/approvals/{approval_id}/{decision}` | responder | Approve or reject a containment request (four-eyes; executes once). |
| GET | `/api/runs` | analyst | Agent runs with outcome, tokens, cost and degraded flag. |
| POST | `/api/hunt` | analyst | Queue a hunt for the agents service; poll GET /api/hunt/{hunt_id} for the result. |
| GET | `/api/hunt/{hunt_id}` | analyst | Hunt status and result. |
| POST | `/api/agents/{kind}/{action}` | responder | Kill switch: any responder may halt an agent (or all); only an admin may resume. Halting is always safe. |
| GET | `/api/audit` | admin | Recent audit entries and chain verification. |
| POST | `/api/ingest/{source}` | HMAC MERIDIAN_INGEST_SECRET[_<SOURCE>] | Signed push into the landing zone: X-Meridian-Timestamp + X-Meridian-Signature over `ts.body`; 300 s window; 10 MB cap. |
| GET | `/services/collector/health/1.0` | - |  |
| GET | `/services/collector/health` | - |  |
| POST | `/services/collector/raw/1.0` | - | Splunk HEC-compatible intake, so existing HEC senders (Cribl, Vector, Fluent Bit, Logstash, SaaS exports) |
| POST | `/services/collector/raw` | - | Splunk HEC-compatible intake, so existing HEC senders (Cribl, Vector, Fluent Bit, Logstash, SaaS exports) |
| POST | `/services/collector/event/1.0` | - | Splunk HEC-compatible intake, so existing HEC senders (Cribl, Vector, Fluent Bit, Logstash, SaaS exports) |
| POST | `/services/collector/event` | - | Splunk HEC-compatible intake, so existing HEC senders (Cribl, Vector, Fluent Bit, Logstash, SaaS exports) |
| POST | `/services/collector` | - | Splunk HEC-compatible intake, so existing HEC senders (Cribl, Vector, Fluent Bit, Logstash, SaaS exports) |
| GET | `/edl/{kind}.txt` | Basic / Bearer MERIDIAN_EDL_TOKEN | External dynamic list (`ip` or `domain`) pulled by firewalls and proxies. |

Interactive API documentation (`/docs`, `/redoc`, `/openapi.json`) is disabled unless `MERIDIAN_API_DOCS=1`.

## MCP endpoints

| Path | Required scope | Tools |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/mcp/lake/` | `lake:read` | describe_schema, search_events, aggregate_events, entity_timeline, ioc_sweep |
| `/mcp/context/` | `context:read` | lookup_asset, lookup_identity, check_indicator, get_alert, related_alerts |
| `/mcp/cases/` | `cases:read` (+ `cases:write` for notes) | get_case, add_case_note |
| `/mcp/response/` | `response:request` | list_actions, request_containment (creates a pending approval only) |

Parameters and limits for every tool: [MCP-TOOLS.md](../MCP-TOOLS.md).

## Response codes used consistently

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 400 | Invalid input (validation message in `detail`) |
| 401 | Not authenticated |
| 403 | Authenticated but the role / scope is insufficient, CSRF token missing, or four-eyes violation |
| 404 | Not found |
| 409 | Approval no longer pending (already decided or expired) |
| 413 | Ingest body above 10 MB |
| 503 | Not ready (`/readyz`) |
